card.name: Digits and decimal points in doses
card.fires_on: The first digit, decimal point, or space of a number right where a dose amount or age is being written, such as 1.2 mg/kg or 50 mcg/kg.

modes.label: Decimal point in a number
modes.description: The point inside a decimal amount, just before the fractional digits.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a whole-number dose or age before more digits follow.

modes.label: Space before a dose
modes.description: The space after a colon or 'is' just before the dose number.
